options: The process of encrypting data as it moves between systems
A method for ranking data sources by cost
The process of tagging all the touchpoints, such as databases, tables, columns and business rules, that data has travelled through on its way to a BI solution or downstream system
A backup schedule for the data warehouse
A list of users permitted to view a report
questions.explanation: Data Lineage tags every touchpoint data passes through, including the ETLs, enrichments, transformations, conversions, aggregations and new measures created along the way.

questions.stem: Data Lineage is described as the single most important factor in preventing what?
options: A Data Lake becoming a Data Swamp
A database exceeding its storage quota
A report running too slowly
Duplicate customer records
Unauthorised access to production systems
questions.explanation: Data Lineage is called the most important factor to save a Data Lake from becoming a Data Swamp.

questions.stem: What must already be in place before efficient Data Lineage can be built?
options: A cloud subscription
A machine learning model
A real-time streaming platform
A customer feedback programme
Metadata
questions.explanation: Efficient Data Lineage cannot be built without Metadata in place.

questions.stem: If a figure shown in a BI solution cannot be tracked back to its source, what does that indicate?
options: The BI tool needs a licence upgrade
There is no Data Lineage, and the organisation is heading towards disaster
The figure is automatically correct
The source system has been decommissioned
The report is being cached
questions.explanation: Being unable to trace BI data to its source means Data Lineage is missing, so in future nobody will know where data comes from or where it is used.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT something Data Lineage shows about data on its journey?
options: The ETLs the data went through
The aggregations and conversions applied
The new measures created along the way
The hardware specification of the source server
The data enrichments and transformations performed
questions.explanation: Data Lineage records ETLs, enrichments, transformations, conversions, aggregations and new measures; hardware specifications are not part of it.

questions.stem: By roughly how much can a proper Data Lineage process reduce the effort required to resolve errors?
questions.explanation: A proper Data Lineage process in place can bring down the effort required to resolve errors by 80%.

questions.stem: In the context of Data Lineage, what does UAM stand for?
options: User Access Metric
Unified Analytics Model
Universal Audit Mechanism
Upstream Aggregation Map
User Activity Monitor
questions.explanation: Data Lineage provides an audit trail of the data lifecycle and helps users understand UAM, the User Access Metric.

questions.stem: How does Data Lineage relate to Data Provenance?
options: They are unrelated disciplines
Data Provenance is a subset of Data Lineage
Data Lineage replaces Data Provenance in modern systems
Data Lineage applies only to unstructured data, Data Provenance only to structured data
Data Lineage is the low-level detail of Data Provenance
questions.explanation: Data Lineage is described as the low-level details of Data Provenance.

questions.stem: Which team does Data Lineage particularly help by tracing data from source to endpoint?
options: The Marketing team
The BAU Support team
The Legal team
The Sales team
The Facilities team
questions.explanation: Data Lineage helps the BAU Support team trace data from its source to the endpoint for research and diagnosis.

questions.stem: What does Data Lineage provide across the enterprise that helps businesses trust their data?
options: A guarantee that data is never wrong
An automatic correction of bad records
A ranking of the most popular reports
An audit trail of the data lifecycle
A replacement for Master Data Management
questions.explanation: Data Lineage provides an audit trail of the data lifecycle throughout the enterprise, helping businesses trust the completeness and accuracy of their data.
